answer: Persistent Presence Windows. Each identity must answer a short, unpredictable challenge at a scheduled slot and again within a fixed interval, so credentials stay alive only through continuous responsive attendance. Missing a slot voids the identity and its history, a ripple through all its pending work. An attacker must staff each sybil through every window, paying real watcher time; idle clones cannot hide. Fable operators cheaply show the cost: a summit of ten thousand bots means ten thousand shifts.
